pay_detail: Summer 2026 Summer College prices for a 1-week, 1-credit program: Indiana resident $725.80 (tuition plus room and board), out-of-state $1,326.25, plus a $60 non-refundable application fee. Scholarships exist.
notes: Residential. Admission is not guaranteed and you list up to three course choices on the application. Prices are 2026 and may change.
name: Agriculture Science Research Institute (ASRI)
org: Purdue University College of Agriculture, Office of Academic Programs
what_you_do: One week on campus doing hands-on research in a College of Agriculture lab. Faculty and grad students guide you. You do over 12 hours of research. It ends with a talk on what you found.
who_can_apply: High school students who are current freshmen, sophomores or juniors. Apply through Purdue Summer College for High School Students.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 are expected to open in December 2026. 2027 deadlines are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Purdue Summer College for High School Students application and pick it as a short-term course choice. Questions go to Anna Egan (williaak@purdue.edu).
